body:
New tenants table + local_users.tenant_id column, explicit compiler-enforced tenantID parameter on every scoped UserProjector method, a real tenant_id JWT claim, callerTenantID(r) threaded through every local_users-touching handler. Found and fixed a real, live security gap along the way: internal/gdpr's own Export/Delete pipeline had zero tenant check anywhere in the chain -- a tenant-A admin could otherwise export or permanently PII-scrub a tenant-B user. Live-verified end to end against the real running binary (two real users, two real tenants, cross-tenant GET /api/v1/users/{uid} and POST /api/v1/gdpr/export both correctly 404, same-tenant access unaffected). New tests at every layer. go build/vet/test all clean.

⚓ ☃
title: Multi-Tenancy Phase 1 shipped: real row-level tenant isolation on local_users + a real GDPR cross-tenant security gap closed
